observations: Prediction defines a strictly increasing subsequence in 3 1 4 1 5 9 2 6.
After first card, incorrectly placing one on a new pile was rejected with precise feedback naming pile one.
Correct placement and automatic remainder produced four downward piles; tracing last pile highlighted original positions for 1 4 5 6 and predecessor links six-five-four-one.
Tracing pile two gave two-one. Reveal gives both upper bound (at most one card per descending pile) and constructive lower bound (predecessors), plus alternate longest sequence 3 4 5 9.
